summary: This function works out a late payment surcharge: it returns zero if the payment has not been made or was made on or before the due date, and otherwise returns ten percent of the energy amount, rounded to two decimal places.

rules.text: If no payment date is recorded, no late payment surcharge is charged and the amount is zero.
If the payment is made after the due date, a late payment surcharge of 10% of the energy amount is charged, rounded to two decimal places.
If the payment is made on or before the due date, no late payment surcharge is charged and the amount is zero.
